clips.text: The puskesmas queue was long that morning. Bu Ratna was holding number 27.
A man walked straight to the counter. A few people began to grumble.
Bu Ratna went over and asked quietly. He only wanted directions to the emergency room.
Bu Ratna showed him the way and sat back down. The queue settled again.
Pak Dodi bought rice and cooking oil at Bu Sum's warung. He paid with a Rp100,000 note.
At home he counted his change. It was Rp20,000 too much.
That afternoon he went back and returned the money.
Bu Sum was relieved. "So that's why the till was short," she said with a smile.
The neighbourhood meeting was set for 7 p.m. Pak Hendra arrived ten minutes early.
At seven, only five residents were there. The rest were still on their way.
Pak Hendra started on time anyway and covered the most important points first.
The meeting ended at 8 p.m., as promised. The next month, more residents came on time.
Pak Yusuf promised to help Bu Meri clear her roof gutter on Sunday.
On Saturday afternoon, his office asked him to work on Sunday.
He told Bu Meri right away and offered Saturday afternoon instead.
On Saturday afternoon, two more neighbours joined in. The gutter was clear before the rain came.
Sari was checking Dimas's sales report before it went to their manager.
One figure had been counted twice. It made the team look as if it had hit its target.
Sari asked Dimas for a quiet word and calmly showed him the figure.
Dimas corrected it and told the manager himself. The manager was grateful to know early.
A customer snapped at Rina because his order was wrong.
Rina took two slow breaths before answering.
"I understand you're upset, sir — I'll replace it now," said Rina. The customer began to calm down.
On her break, Rina told a colleague about it. Putting her feelings into words helped her feel lighter.
Maya was asked to choose a caterer for an office event.
One caterer offered her a "thank-you payment" if she chose them.
Maya politely said no and noted the offer for her manager.
She compared three quotes and chose the best one. Everyone knew how the choice was made.
A chain message arrived in the residents' group: "Main road closed all day tomorrow!"
Bu Nanik didn't forward it straight away. She checked the kelurahan's official account.
It turned out to be last year's notice. She replied kindly, with the official link.
The first sender thanked her. The group calmed down again.
